title: Norseen report under NASA weather contract N66001
place_text: Navy SPAWAR Systems Center, San Diego

tellings.quote: According to Norseen citation, that report was funded under the contract N66001. [music]

plain: Researcher John Norseen's report on a brain-computer link for pilot cockpits was paid for under a government contract numbered N66001, a contract this story connects to NASA weather work run through a Navy systems center in San Diego. Michels says this himself, based on Norseen's own citation of the report. He brings it up to show that the mind-control research was hidden under an unrelated contract.
